head_coach.name: Steve Clarke
head_coach.play_style_summary: Pragmatic and defensively solid style built on structural discipline and a compact mid-block. Tactics focus heavily on rapid vertical transitions, utilizing energetic wing-backs and direct attacking midfielders who make late runs into the opposition penalty box.

key_players.name: Scott McTominay
key_players.performance_stats: Achieved a 7.24 average match rating across 33 games in the 2025/26 Serie A season for Napoli, registering 1,885 touches, 101 shots, and 34 shots on target [3.1.4].

key_players.name: John McGinn
key_players.performance_stats: Appeared in 30 Premier League matches during the 2025/26 campaign for Aston Villa, demonstrating high-intensity pressing, exceptional leadership, and outstanding ball-winning capabilities in central areas.

key_players.name: Ben Gannon-Doak
key_players.performance_stats: Made 8 Premier League appearances in the 2025/26 season for Bournemouth following a £25m transfer, proving to be a highly explosive, direct threat in 1v1 situations with elite acceleration.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Sustained a Grade II sprain to his right knee in a warm-up friendly against Curaçao on May 30, 2026, ruling him out of the 2026 FIFA World Cup [4.2.5].
Ruled out of the 2026 World Cup squad due to injury, which opened up a squad place for Ross Stewart.
